verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local model-inference engine, so vision-language model support is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only text chat with MoE models, SSD expert offload, LoRA adapters and an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. Nothing mentions image inputs, vision encoders or multimodal models.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run vision-language models that understand images alongside text
